description: Frontend play and results experience. Two-step instant myth-vs-fact feedback (Check answer -> feedback -> Next) with streak and n/3 progress, reduced-motion safe; topic key-takeaway panel first on Results; new SteerHandoff component (four-step journey, 'See if the programme fits you' / 'Talk to a Steer doctor', no data sent, cta_context analytics) used on Results and Explore; 'Knowledge score' wording; share text/PNG disclaimer; privacy copy. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Read plan.md sections 3, 6 and FEAT-003; re-read src/pages/Play.tsx, Results.tsx, Explore.tsx, Challenge.tsx, src/components/{LearningTakeaways,ShareSheet}.tsx, src/services/{download,sharing}.ts, src/App.tsx privacy dialog and the CSS around .answer-card, .quiz-controls, .progress-heading, .results-page, .achievement-card.

src/pages/Play.tsx: dynamic import of ../data/approved in an effect; implement select -> 'Check answer' -> feedback panel (role=status, aria-live polite; text headings '✓ Spot on' / '↗ Good to know'; explanation; first source link with rel noopener noreferrer) -> 'Next question' / 'See my results'; lock radios once checked; persist draft.checked via saveDraft; streak chip ('2 in a row'); keep 'Question n of 3', <progress>, add n/3 step markers; if revealAnswer is undefined skip the check step; keep the frozen pending/retry path and submission payload unchanged.

Add a 200-250ms feedback pop/slide-in and progress transition in src/styles/learning.css; ensure every new animation/transition is neutralised by the existing prefers-reduced-motion rule in src/App.css (e2e asserts animationName 'none' under reduced motion). No new dependencies.

Create src/components/TopicTakeaway.tsx (heading size >= score heading, topic label, takeaway text, 'Educational only, not medical advice.', link 'Want a doctor to look at your own numbers?' scrolling to the handoff) and render it first in Results.tsx using review?.topic (GENERAL fallback). Update LearningTakeaways footer per plan D10 using contentReview.reviewedBy (never claim review while null).

Create src/components/SteerHandoff.tsx with the verbatim four steps, footnote and two CTAs from plan.md section 3; hrefs from steerDestination(...), target _blank, rel 'noopener noreferrer'; onClick track('CTA_CLICKED', { destination: 'STEER_WEBSITE', ctaContext }) with ctaContext in results_programme_fit | results_talk_to_doctor | explore_programme_fit | explore_talk_to_doctor. Use it in Results.tsx (replacing the generic 'Explore Steer' link) and Explore.tsx (replacing hero CTA + care-grid; keep DoctorChecklist). Responsive CSS, >=44px targets.

Rename 'Knowledge points' to 'Knowledge score' (Results.tsx, Challenge.tsx). Add shareDisclaimer ('Game performance only. Not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.') to src/services/sharing.ts and use it in ShareSheet text/preview and src/services/download.ts PNG; no topic or answers in shared content. Update App.tsx privacy dialog copy per plan.

Repair existing tests/scripts only: answerQuiz and finishQuiz helpers click 'Check answer' before Next/See my results; Explore/handoff link assertions use 'See if the programme fits you'; standalone test; scripts/verify-playable.mjs gets the check step and handoff assertions (rel noopener noreferrer, no '?' in href). Do not add new tests.

After 'Check answer' the myth-vs-fact explanation, textual correct/incorrect heading and source appear before moving on; streak and n/3 shown; keyboard-only flow works (arrow keys do not auto-lock)
